C-RETIRE-23-35.Name: Retire the superseded drafts C-23 and C-35 from the active set
C-RETIRE-23-35.Summary: C-23 (Release 2.3.0 without beta) and C-35 (Website refresh) are RETIRED DRAFTS by the C-72 disposition of 2026-10-20: the first is obsolete because v2.3.0 and v2.3.1 shipped via the release train, the second is superseded by the approved C-64 site-refresh bundle that shipped (mark.xronocode.com live). Both folders stayed under active/ only because the GRACE framework requires a compliant applied plan for archival and a spec-only draft never had one. The owner decision of 2026-10-23 ("архивируй 23 и 35") supplies that closure: this bundle is the applied plan that moves them to archive with their dispositions preserved.

Problem.Description: Two retired, non-executable draft bundles pollute the active set: grace status counts them as active changes and every future reconciliation has to step around them.

Goals.R-1: Move C-23 and C-35 from .grace/changes/active/ to .grace/changes/archive/ with wrapper status applied and an AppliedEvidence record naming the owner decision; the RETIRED DRAFT disposition text inside each spec stays byte-identical.
Goals.R-2: Gates hold after the move: grace lint 0 errors, parallel-preflight clean, active set reduced to four parked drafts plus C-50.

Constraints.Constraint: No product code changes; only .grace/changes paths move.
C-36, C-37, C-47 and C-50 stay untouched (parked backlog, pending their own dispositions).
The parallel session's release-materials work stays unstaged and untouched.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Any graph or verification anchor change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .grace/changes/active contains exactly C-36, C-37, C-47 and C-50; the archive holds C-23 and C-35 with applied status.
grace lint --assertions current reports 0 errors and --parallel-preflight exits clean.

C-RETIRE-23-35.VerificationIntent: grace lint --assertions current; grace lint --parallel-preflight; grace status active-set listing.

Approval.ApprovedBy: owner (2026-10-23, chat; translated from Russian): "archive 23 and 35" - the instruction that followed the anti-drift report explaining both dispositions.
Approval.ApprovalScope: Archival of the two retired drafts only.
